properties.name: Surface NixOS host
properties.description: The Surface Pro 8 NixOS system flake (~56 configuration_*.nix modules): LUKS+USB-keyfile, btrfs subvolume autocreate + impermanence (root tmpfs), KDE Plasma 6, linux-surface kernel, and a full system-protection suite (disk/battery/storage, session isolation, rescue, hibernate guards, kernel preservation).

properties.name: bootloader engine
properties.description: Owns ALL boot management (NixOS yields to it). Renders rEFInd (primary) + GRUB (secondary) configs and NVRAM entries FROM the nix store generations (render-refind-conf/render-grub-cfg/render-nvram), enabling multi-boot: NixOS + Debian-rescue + Kali + Windows + Ventoy. build.sh deploy after any boot-affecting flake change.

properties.name: home-manager desktop
properties.description: Pure home-manager flake for workstations (153 modules: ai/claude+gemini+ant, browsers, build-tools, containers-cloud, cloud-network-wg-dns/public). Hosts surface + server. Source of THIS CLAUDE.md (dotfiles/claude). Consumes cloud-data-derived JSON for npm deps + WG.

properties.name: home-manager termux
properties.description: nix-on-droid home-manager (this device). wireguard.nix + wireguard-wstunnel.nix (WG-over-TCP/443 fallback), node-npm-deps-{cloud,front}, claude/gemini dotfiles + guard hooks, pinned pkgs (claude-code, octocode, goose, ant) via autoPatchelfHook. mcp.json.tpl → ~/.mcp.json.

properties.name: unix ship engine
properties.description: Same universal build.sh engine (switch|boot|test|build|burn). unix-ship-repo-workflow-engine.sh + shared libs (engine-traps, ensure-deps, inject-header). Builds/activates the host + HM flakes; builds bootable artefacts (iso/qcow/vm).

properties.name: desktop app flakes (da_*)
properties.description: Standalone home-module flakes: autofill-rbw-rofi (Rust rbw→rofi typer), browser-qute, fido2-vault-broker (Rust CTAP2/UHID FIDO2 backed by Bitwarden+TPM seal), waydroid-apps, waydroid-sensors. Each = build.sh + src/flake.nix → home-module.nix.

properties.name: fido2-vault-broker
properties.description: Rust software FIDO2 authenticator: presents a UHID device (uhid_dev), implements CTAP2 (ctap2: COSE P-256), persists resident keys in Bitwarden (store/bw_api+bw_keystore) sealed to the TPM (store/tpm_seal). Wired into the NixOS host via configuration_fido2-vault-broker.nix.

properties.name: cloud Android super-apps (ea_*)
properties.description: Gradle/Kotlin Android apps fronting the cloud: cloud-comms (mail/chat/matrix), cloud-ide (editor/files), cloud-nav (maps), cloud-superapp (browser/cal/chat/fin/health/vault/wallet tabs). build.sh bundles forks + signs; cloud-superapp self-updates from GHCR.

properties.name: rescue + fallback media
properties.description: Out-of-band recovery: Debian rescue-OS bootstrap, Ventoy fallback USB (arch/alpine/debian-slim/nixos-surface-slim live builders), and chroot-into helpers (rescue-chroot-nixos.sh, unix-chroot.sh) to repair an unbootable host.

properties.name: Kali security desktop
properties.description: Kali debootstrap OS + a scanning container (scanner/safety-analyzer/survey-wifi/reporter) for authorized security testing.

properties.name: cloud-data derived JSON (consumed)
properties.description: node-npm-deps-{cloud,front}, cloud-network-wg-dns/public read cloud-data-derived JSON (external-consumers registry). unix consumes; cloud emits.

properties.name: rEFInd/GRUB/NVRAM entries
properties.description: Rendered boot config the firmware reads, produced from nix-store generations.

properties.name: vm-pilot / HM GHCR images
properties.description: Container images the cloud VMs pull to activate home-manager (built from this repo's flakes consumed by cloud b_infra).

properties.rationale: boot entries derived from the host's store paths
home-manager user env over the NixOS system
npm deps + WG config derived from cloud-data
HM delivered to cloud VMs as GHCR images

properties.via: out-of-band repair when the host won't boot
